qualityInfo.label: How quality is calculated
qualityInfo.title: How quality is calculated
qualityInfo.intro: A 0–100% score of the current result of each product. A value only counts when it cites a source.

weights.required: Required attributes filled with evidence (the required coverage)
weights.published: Relevant attributes (required, or with a proposed value) published with evidence
weights.sources: Source quality: the best source of each fact (official 100%, authorized distributor 90%, recognized retailer 75%, other 50%)
weights.confidence: Average confidence of the published values

qualityInfo.penalties: Deductions: 10 points per critical error, such as an invalid GTIN, a missing required attribute or a value without a source (up to 40); 3 per other error (up to 12); 0.5 per warning (up to 5). Pre-approved out-of-vocabulary values cost nothing.
qualityInfo.coverage: Required coverage is the share of required attributes that have a value with evidence.
qualityInfo.averaged: Here both numbers are the average of the products already enriched; products not enriched yet are not counted.
